title: The Free Kick — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational soccer philosophy 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Spanish French language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The free kick is a gift the referee has given
A moment twenty-four yards out where something can be driven
The wall lines up and jumps at entirely the wrong moment
The goalkeeper goes left and that was not the best component

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El tiro libre es un regalo del árbitro bien dado
[The free kick is a gift well given by the referee]
Un momento a veinte metros donde todo es calculado
[A moment at twenty metres where everything is calculated]
La barrera salta pero no en el momento correcto
[The wall jumps but not at the right moment]
El portero va a la izquierda — no fue el efecto perfecto
[The goalkeeper goes left — that wasn't the perfect effect]

[Chorus — English]
The free kick knows something I don't know
It knows the angle between the wall and where the keeper'll go
The free kick is a calculation done in under three seconds flat
By a man who trained for twenty years to do exactly that
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le coup franc est une opportunité offerte par l'arbitre
[The free kick is an opportunity offered by the referee]
Un moment suspendu entre la règle et le calibre
[A moment suspended between the rule and the caliber]
Le mur se lève trop tôt, le gardien va à gauche
[The wall rises too soon, the goalkeeper goes left]
Et le ballon entre dans le filet — rien ne cloche
[And the ball enters the net — nothing is wrong]

[Outro — All three languages]
Free kick knows… El tiro libre sabe… Le coup franc sait
Angle before technique — Ángulo antes de técnica — Angle avant technique
That's my boy
